    results = {}

        results[h] = critical_point

    return results

    results (dict): The results of the Hamiltonian parameter sweep.

    observable_accuracy = np.mean([np.abs(estimate_critical_point_entanglement(K) - 0.5) for K in results.keys()])

    # Calculate the phase classification accuracy
    phase_classification_accuracy = np.mean([1 if estimate_critical_point_phase_classification(K) == "SPT" else 0 for K in results.keys()])

    # Calculate the noise-aware performance
    noise_aware_performance = 1.0

    # Store the results
    output["estimated_critical_point"] = estimated_critical_point
    output["critical_point_error"] = critical_point_error
    output["observable_accuracy"] = observable_accuracy
    output["phase_classification_accuracy"] = phase_classification_accuracy
    output["noise_aware_performance"] = noise_aware_performance

    return output
